prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE original battle-ready enemy sprite illustration for industrial fantasy action RPG, M23 Polarity Tug from an abandoned underground hangar. Its strong OPEN U-SHAPED silhouette is formed by a large two-prong magnetic fork rising from a very low compact trolley chassis. Between the U prongs a single heavy mineral-and-iron cargo sphere hangs visibly suspended with a clear air gap all around it. The open hole and floating ball must be unmistakable, no solid torso filling the fork. Small rugged drive rollers beneath the low trolley, braided copper electromagnet windings and ivory ceramic terminal caps at the two fork tips. Forks are partly closing around the ball, preparing a short push/pull magnetic pulse; tiny cyan and amber terminal indicators without letters or arrows. No human shape, no face, no gun or manipulator arms. Salvaged loading equipment subtly animated by mineral fibers, coal-black steel, oxidized copper and restrained worn ochre panels, no excessive surface noise. Premium richly hand-painted stylized industrial-fantasy, beautiful readable sculptural forms, broad painterly light/shadow, fine details only at functional joints. Elevated three-quarter view looking down 40 degrees, complete trolley and fork tips and ball, 12 percent empty safety margin, readable at 70 pixels as a hollow U and sphere. Nearly opaque solid metal and sphere; genuine transparent alpha outside and through open gaps. No scene, floor, ground shadow, pedestal, aura, electric field graphic, smoke, text, logo, UI, watermark, border or existing franchise resemblance.
